subject: Renewal + expansion: proposal for additional GPU tranche after Q2 usage surge
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@greenwavehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@greenwavehealth.com>, procurement@greenwavehealth.com
Date: 2026-06-30T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q2 spike & renewal conversation

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last quarter. We closed out Q2 yesterday and saw a sustained ~75-85% utilization on the dedicated fleet you provisioned for our gen-chat workload. Traffic patterns have changed — more concurrent sessions and longer context windows — and we expect that baseline to hold through H2.

Our renewal is up in mid-August and we want to discuss whether to simply renew current capacity or add another tranche to avoid throttling during peak windows. Can you share a recommended sizing plan and rough delta on monthly committed spend? Procurement also wants clarity on migration downtime and any configuration changes.

Attaching the Q2 usage extract for your reference.

Best,
Emma Li
Director of AI Platforms
Greenwave Health

Attachment: greenwave_q2_utilization_summary.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 spike & renewal conversation

Hi Emma — thanks for the data and the heads-up. Tom/Procurement, nice to loop you in.

Quick summary up front: based on the attached usage and our telemetry, Greenwave's fleet hit sustained tail latency increases during the 11:00–15:00 PT window when concurrent sessions rose >20%. To preserve your 99th percentile SLOs we recommend adding a +16-GPU tranche (recommended config: 2x A100s or equivalent quantized pods) with an optional autoscale buffer for peak bursts.

What this buys you:
- Headroom to bring 99p response times back in-line during daytime peak windows
- Reduced queueing and fewer token rejections when context lengths exceed historical median
- Staged rollout: canary one pod, then ramp to full tranche over 48 hours to avoid warm-cache cold-start disruption

I attached a proposal addendum with pricing delta and an initial runbook. High-level commercial delta: estimated committed increase ~$18k/month for the tranche (list + volume discounts applied). We can convert to a blended committed rate if you prefer longer-term pricing.

Next steps I propose:
1) Technical review with Dev and your infra team (I'll schedule) — confirm model variants and kernel compatibility
2) Procurement confirms preferred billing cadence (monthly/quarterly) and sends PO window
3) Sign addendum (DocuSign link to follow) and schedule a canary/rollout week

Happy to hop on a call today or tomorrow.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: proposed_tranche_addendum_v1.docx (DOCX, 45KB), runbook_capacity-migration.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Q2 spike & renewal conversation

Emma — quick technical notes from the infra side:

- The utilization spike you’re seeing aligns with longer prompt contexts and more concurrent agents. The two levers we recommend are (A) add the dedicated tranche to raise baseline throughput and (B) tune batching windows during the 11:00–15:00 window to avoid token starvation.
- We can provision the tranche as quantized 8-GPU pods (2 pods = 16 GPUs) that match the existing model variant. That avoids cross-variant fallbacks and keeps latency stable.
- Canary plan: route 20% of production traffic to the new tranche for 6 hours, inspect 95/99p latencies and memory GC. If stable, ramp to 100% over next 36–48 hours. No migration downtime expected; warm KV caching is the main sensitivity.

Questions for Greenwave team:
- Do you have a freeze window for changes to the inference stack for July?
- Can you accept a staged rollout starting with one pod on the first day?

I’ll prepare a short runbook for the canary steps (heat-up, perf checks, rollback triggers).

—Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai

1) Can you provide a 1-page cost breakdown (committed vs burst) for the proposed +16 GPU tranche? Procurement wants list + discounted committed pricing separated out.
2) Are there any expected performance regressions when moving to 8-GPU quantized pods for our current model variants? Our legal team also asked about retention of KV cache logs during the canary.

Emma — a couple of infra/compliance clarifications from my side: 

- No performance regressions expected from the quantized 8-GPU pod profile for your current model if we pin the model variant and use the same tokenization/precision profile. We'll run head-to-head perf checks during the canary to validate.
- KV cache logs: by default we retain golden-logs for 30 days in your private bucket; we can extend or provide an S3 snapshot on request for audit. That will not impact rollout.
- Maintenance freeze noted: we will schedule provisioning outside July 20–22. Recommended provisioning window: Aug 3–5 so warm caches are established before your renewal on Aug 14.

I will add rollback triggers to the runbook (95p latency delta > 20% or error rate > 0.5% over 30 minutes) and share the finalized runbook once Dev completes the perf checklist.

—Rishi
